words.zh: n. 虚构；小说；虚构的事；小说，虚构作品
words.example: The novel blends historical facts with pure fiction.

words.zh: phr. 科幻小说（=sci-fi，有时也可指代科幻电影）
words.example: Many students enjoy reading science fiction for its imaginative future worlds.

words.zh: phr. 彻底检查，仔细检查；检验；测试
words.example: The engineers will test out the new solar battery next week.

words.zh: n. 奖金，额外津贴；意外收获；红利；奖金，红利，意外收获，额外奖励
words.example: The team received a bonus for finishing the project early.

words.zh: phr. 更像是；说...还差不多；更接近
words.example: It is more like a dream than a real memory.

words.zh: adj. 可笑的，荒谬的；愚蠢的
words.example: It is ridiculous to think that robots would rule the world.

words.zh: n. 正直，真诚；完整；完好；【财】诚信正直
words.example: A scientist must value honesty and integrity when reporting results.

words.zh: n. 尊严；威严；端庄
words.example: She faced the difficult situation with courage and dignity.

words.zh: vt. 给...加薪，给...薪水；  n. 工资，薪水
words.example: Her salary is paid monthly into her bank account.

words.zh: adj. 不合理的；可笑的，荒唐的；荒谬的；  n. 荒唐的事
words.example: The idea that the earth is flat seems absurd to modern students.

words.zh: n. 预约；委派；任命；制定；约会
words.example: I have an appointment with the principal this afternoon.

words.zh: v. 将……钉牢，钉住；固定；  n. 指甲，爪；钉；趾甲
words.example: The student hammered the nail into the board.

words.zh: n. 女推销员，女销售员
words.example: The saleswoman recommended a cheaper phone to the young customer.

words.zh: adj. 内疚的；负罪的；有过失的
words.example: He felt guilty about forgetting his friend's birthday.

words.zh: v. 悬挂，吊；中止；推迟；使有悬念；取消；偿付债务；暂停；悬浮；【计】挂起；【化】悬浮；  vt. 使暂时停职（或停学等）
words.example: The school may suspend a student who cheats on an exam.

words.zh: n. 梯子；阶梯；  vi. （长筒袜等）抽丝
words.example: He climbed the ladder to reach the books on the top shelf.

words.zh: v. 开除；不考虑；解散；让（某人）离开；消除；解雇；否定；对……不屑一提；【法】驳回
words.example: The teacher decided to dismiss the class five minutes early.

words.zh: v. 宣布，宣告；表明；宣称，声称；断言；申报；（在击球员还未全部出局时）宣布结束赛局
words.example: The judge will declare the winner of the science competition tomorrow.

words.zh: conj. 然而，但是，尽管；【法】鉴于，就……而论
words.example: Some students prefer online classes, whereas others enjoy traditional classrooms.

words.zh: n. 谣言，传闻；【财】谣言；  v. 谣传，传闻
words.example: A rumour spread that the school would close for a week.

words.zh: v. 假定；推测；擅自行事；利用；以…...为先决条件；【财】假设
words.example: I presume the experiment results will be ready by Friday.

words.zh: n. 交通费；票价；食物；出租车乘客；  v. （事情）进行得（好或坏）
words.example: The bus fare is two dollars for students.

words.zh: adv. 一周一次地；  adj. 每周的，一周一次的；  n. 周报，周刊
words.example: The students hand in a weekly summary of what they have learned.

words.zh: v. 计算；估计；计划；核算；预测；【化】计算，推算；【航】计算
words.example: We need to calculate the total cost of the field trip.

words.zh: n. 女主席，女会长，女董事长
words.example: The chairwoman opened the meeting with a brief speech.

words.zh: n. 克
words.example: A single gramme of the powder is enough to colour the solution.

words.zh: n. 面粉；粉状物质，（谷物磨成的）粉；  v. 撒上粉；研成粉末
words.example: Mix the flour with water to make a simple paste.

words.zh: n. 审判地；犯罪地点；发生地点；集合地点；活动场地（如音乐厅、会场等）；场地
words.example: The school gymnasium is the venue for the annual talent show.

words.zh: n. 男推销员，男售货员
words.example: The salesman explained the features of the new computer.

words.zh: n. 外星人；外国人；  adj. 陌生的；外国的；异己的，不相容的；外星（人）的
words.example: In the film, the alien communicates with humans through symbols.

words.zh: phr. 事物的利与弊；支持与反对
words.example: Before choosing a career, we should weigh the pros and cons.

words.zh: v. 动词blur的过去式和过去分词；  adj. 难以区分的；模糊不清的；记不清的
words.example: The photograph was blurred because the camera moved suddenly.

words.zh: n. 上级；  adj. （级别/重要性）更高的；出众的；更好的；占优势的；质量上乘的，优质的
words.example: The new model offers superior sound quality compared with the old one.

words.zh: phr. 高于……，优于……，更胜一筹
words.example: This laptop is superior to the older version in every aspect.

words.zh: phr. 接收，接管，接任，夺取；占上风；取代
words.example: The robot may take over many boring jobs in the future.

words.zh: n. 无行动；无为；不采取措施
words.example: His inaction during the emergency caused serious consequences.

words.zh: phr. 抵触；与……冲突
words.example: Students should avoid activities that conflict with their study time.

words.zh: v. 劳动；为…迷惑；过于详尽地阐述；  vi. 奋斗；努力工作；  n. （体力）劳动；劳动者；分娩；劳动力；劳动；  adj. 工党的，支持工党的
words.example: The workers laboured all day to build the new school library.

words.zh: n. 皮革；皮制品；  vt. 用皮鞭抽打；用皮革覆盖；  pl. 皮衣，皮外套
words.example: The old chair is covered with soft brown leather.

words.zh: n. 杠杆；控制杆；施加影响的手段；  v. 用杠杆移动；撬开
words.example: The mechanic used a long iron bar to lever the heavy rock out of the mud.

words.zh: n. 讨论小组，专家咨询组；仪表板；面板；  v. 镶嵌
words.example: A panel of experts discussed the ethical issues raised by artificial intelligence.

words.zh: v. （使）缓慢地移动；使渐进；  n. 英寸；少许，少量；【数】英寸（长度单位，1英寸等于2.54厘米）
words.example: The robot inched forward along the narrow corridor, scanning for danger.

words.zh: adv. 向后，倒着，往回；反过来；退步，每况愈下
words.example: She walked backwards while filming the science fiction scene in the corridor.

words.zh: v. 握紧，抓牢；  n. 紧握，握力；掌握，控制，影响
words.example: The astronaut tightened her grip on the handrail as the spacecraft shook.

words.zh: adj. 朦胧的，烟雾弥漫的，模糊的；迷惑的
words.example: My memory of the dream is hazy, but the robot's red eyes remain clear.

words.zh: n. 侄女，外甥女
words.example: My niece loves reading science fiction and often borrows my books.

words.zh: vt. 取来；接来，请来；使发出；售得；带来；接住；  vi. 取物；  n. 拿来，取来；诡计；风浪区；  v. 抵达，到达
words.example: Could you fetch the control panel from the storage room for our experiment?

words.zh: n. 手帕；头巾；方巾；纸巾； 围巾
words.example: She wiped the dust from the old machine with a clean handkerchief.

words.zh: n. 灯，台灯；【物】灯泡
words.example: The only light in the cabin came from a small lamp above the desk.

words.zh: phr. 结果是，证明是；生产；制造；关闭，熄灭；翻转；出席（某项活动），在场；使朝外
words.example: The strange device turned out to be a harmless science project.

words.zh: n. 速度；步伐；节奏；  vi. 踱步；确定速度；调整节奏
words.example: The scientist increased the pace of the experiment to finish before the deadline.

words.zh: phr. 逐渐减少；消失；疏远；背离，离开；抛弃；消瘦；倾斜
words.example: As the rocket climbed, the roar of the engines slowly fell away.

words.zh: n. 分，分配；除法；部门；分裂；分开，分隔；差异
words.example: The division of labor among the team made the project more efficient.

words.zh: v. 喷出；膨胀，肿胀；吹捧；一口口抽烟；  n. 一口（气味，烟雾）；一阵，一股；喷出；粉扑；呼吸；（烟、气等的）一缕；少量；喘息；  adj. 吹嘘的
words.example: A white puff of smoke rose from the engine as it started.

words.zh: v. 催促；敦促，督促；鞭策，鼓动；力荐，主张；强烈要求；  n. 冲动；强烈的愿望
words.example: The teacher urged her students to think carefully before choosing an answer.

words.zh: phr. 有强烈的欲望做某事
words.example: After reading the novel, I had an urge to write my own science fiction story.

words.zh: n. 随意，胡乱；  adj. 随机的；任意的；不可思议的；随意的；【数】随机的
words.example: The computer selected a random number to determine the order of presentations.

words.zh: n. 最大值；最大限度；【化】最大值，最大限度；【数】最大值；  adj. 最大的
words.example: The maximum speed of the test vehicle was secretly recorded by the researchers.

words.zh: vt. 爆破；  vi. 爆炸；爆发；激增；大发雷霆；突然活跃起来
words.example: If the pressure becomes too high, the container may explode with great force.

words.zh: n. 猛的一击，摇晃，颠簸；  v. （使）颠簸，摇晃；使震惊
words.example: The sudden jolt of the spaceship made everyone grab their seats.

words.zh: v. 把……往上抛；掷；抽打；用指轻弹；空翻；（使）快速翻转；【数】翻转；  adj. 轻率的，无礼的
words.example: She flipped the switch to start the machine, and the lights flickered.

words.zh: v. 使昏迷，使发愣
words.example: The unexpected discovery stunned the entire research team and changed their plan.

words.zh: n. 泥；泥浆
words.example: After the rain, the path was covered in sticky mud and difficult to walk through.

words.zh: n. 夸大；夸张
words.example: It is no overstatement to say that this discovery will change our future.
